title: 06/28/2024 - Software Update | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 06/28/2024 - Software Update Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100556 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We fixed an issue which was preventing the new Send Newsletter module from working properly when sites are connected with specific TLDs like ".com.au" in some cases. We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Send Newsletter module in the Admin. The Subscriptions tab in the Member Dashboard is now fully compatible with Text Labels. Text Label Involved: primary_membership_subscription We fixed an issue which was causing a miscalculation in the prorated upgrade amount to charge when the "Proration: Deduct First Day Usage From Proration Calculation" setting was active in some cases. The [me=XXXX] notation is now compatible for use in Text Labels. The Billing Information data table in the Member Dashboard is now compatible with mobile devices. A customizable Member Tag will now be automatically assigned to all member imported via CSV file. We fixed an issue that was causing the system to create an additional invoice when a member purchased a Digital Product with a recurring subscription without having a credit card on file prior to the purchase. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to upload PDF files through the Media Manager in the Admin area in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from rendering the feed generated by the "RSS Feed for Posts" Add-On on the frontend in some cases. We updated the Dynamic Sub-Sub Category Filtering widgets to pre-select the categories originally selected for member searches performed from the homepage. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Lead System from sending the Admin Notification Email after submitting a new lead on the site in some cases. Widget Involved: System - SaveForm The delete_images, d elete_categories, create_new_categories, send_lead_email_notifications and send_review_email variables now support Boolean values (true or false) when using the Brilliant Directories API. We fixed an issue which was preventing searches for "Event" Post Types from returning accurate results when using the date range filter in some cases. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Events Search - Post - Search Query We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Import Business Data tool in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from rendering single-image post forms when the Default Website Languages and Text Labels were set to French. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Single Photo Upload For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
